title: Agent recipe
description: Where one coding agent keeps its instructions and hooks, and what its hooks are called. install.sh checks every recipe against this schema (types, required fields, no unknown fields, $ref) before it installs anything.

name.description: The agent's name, as messages show it.

variable.description: The environment variable the agent reads to move its directory.

default.description: The directory when the variable is unset; a leading ~ is the home directory.

instructions.description: The file in home the agent reads into every session; the standards go in it between markers.

hook_config.description: The JSON file in home that registers hooks, as {"hooks": {<event>: [{"matcher", "hooks": [<command>]}]}}.

events.description: The agent's event and tool names for each moment a hook runs. A moment left out is not hooked.

after_edit.description: After the agent's edit tools change a file.

turn_end.description: When the agent finishes a turn.

edited_files.description: A jq filter that turns the after_edit hook input into the absolute paths of the files edited, one per output.

after_install.description: What the user still has to do once the installer is done.

matcher.description: The tool names it applies to, as the agent's matcher syntax.
